title: Christmas Eve Brunch
seo_title: Christmas Eve Brunch at Vineyard Market in Ozark, MO
description: Brunch at Vineyard Market on Christmas Eve morning, with holiday food and specials before the day's festivities. Reservations are taken by phone at (417) 882-0399, and the restaurant is closed for the rest of the holiday and all of Christmas Day. It runs Thursday, December 24, 2026, from 10:30 AM to 3:00 PM at 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
